comments.body:
Short version: implicit auto-response does **not** bypass user access.

Flow for an unmentioned follow-up:

1. The broad entrypoint may wake on a non-bot `created` issue/PR comment or submitted PR review if the target already has the fixed `agent` label: [agent-entrypoint.yml](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/7ef46d3c6be1e5fa3520df760a3b0dee705943df/.github/workflows/agent-entrypoint.yml#L48-L80).
2. The router marks it as `implicit_followup=true`, then preauthorizes the `answer` route using the commenter’s `author_association` plus `AGENT_ACCESS_POLICY`: [agent-router.yml](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/7ef46d3c6be1e5fa3520df760a3b0dee705943df/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L249-L262).
3. Only if that preauth resolves to `answer` does Sepo resolve the follow-up provider and run the intent gate: [agent-router.yml](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/7ef46d3c6be1e5fa3520df760a3b0dee705943df/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L279-L285), [agent-router.yml](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/7ef46d3c6be1e5fa3520df760a3b0dee705943df/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L350-L354).
4. The intent gate can only produce `respond` or `ignore`; `respond` is forced through `answer`, and denied `answer` maps back to no route: [resolve-dispatch.ts](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/7ef46d3c6be1e5fa3520df760a3b0dee705943df/.agent/src/cli/resolve-dispatch.ts#L151-L190).

So for users without allowed access: the workflow may start from the cheap label/event prefilter, but the implicit path is dropped silently before the follow-up intent model runs and before any answer is posted.

Default allowed associations are `OWNER`, `MEMBER`, `COLLABORATOR`, and `CONTRIBUTOR` for both public and private repos: [access-policy.md](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/7ef46d3c6be1e5fa3520df760a3b0dee705943df/.agent/docs/customization/access-policy.md#L75-L80). So a prior contributor without repo write access can still trigger `answer` by default. If we want stricter public behavior, set `AGENT_ACCESS_POLICY`, for example:

```json
{"allowed_associations":["OWNER","MEMBER","COLLABORATOR"]}
```

Docs currently state the same behavior: unmentioned implicit follow-ups are answer-only and are dropped silently when `answer` is not authorized: [supported-workflows.md](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/7ef46d3c6be1e5fa3520df760a3b0dee705943df/.agent/docs/usage/supported-workflows.md#L210-L224).

---
`codex` | `gpt-5.5/xhigh` | `Macmini-runner-6`

title: How does automatic response work with user accesses?
